newsitem.title: USA: VideoLan says class action is meritless.
newsitem.headline: VideoLan says class action is meritless.

text.p: VideoLan Technologies Inc said Thursday it believes claims in a recently-filed class action lawsuit in which it is the defendent are without merit.

Plantiffs attorneys said Tuesday that investors who bought VideoLan's stock between November 7, 1995 and May 28, 1996 filed a suit on May 9 in which they allege the company artificially inflated its stock price by misrepresenting an agreement with Samsung Co of South Korea.
VideoLan said it has not received a copy of the complaint, but it has received a press release issued by attorneys for the plaintiffs.
The company said it plans to vigorously defend itself against the suit.
